root_cause.text: The net shaper code fails to include a liveness check on the net_device when transitioning from a reference obtained during Netlink pre-callbacks to RCU-protected access, allowing use of the shaper hierarchy after the netdev has been unregistered and potentially freed.
root_cause.evidence: The patch introduces `net_shaper_hierarchy_rcu()` which verifies `READ_ONCE(binding->netdev->reg_state) <= NETREG_REGISTERED` before accessing the hierarchy, and applies it in `net_shaper_lookup()` and `net_shaper_nl_get_dumpit()`. The commit message explicitly states that "a conversion from a ref to a locked netdev must include a liveness check".
